reason: A memory and context plugin that probes the local Windows environment, persists environment and session summaries across sessions, and injects a bounded profile into system prompts.

summaries.zh: 该插件探测本地环境并持久化跨会话的环境与会话摘要，再将有限摘要注入系统提示以提供上下文。
summaries.en: This plugin probes the local environment, persists environment and session summaries across sessions, and injects a bounded profile into system prompts for added context.

capabilities: Probes selected local tools, paths, network connectivity, and disk I/O
Persists environment and session statistics in local JSON storage
Collects tool-call and session timing, error, and token metadata
Injects a bounded environment summary into each system prompt
Provides an env_profile query tool for stored profile data
